author: Disney
description:
D23 Inside Disney takes to the runway with a behind-the-scenes look at "The Devil Wears Prada 2". Hear from Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, and more stars; get a fantastical inside look at the fashion; and step onto the red carpet at the world premiere. See "The Devil Wears Prada 2" in theaters tonight.
